description: This file defines composable UI components for rendering chat messages in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes components for chat bubbles, message content display (text and images), typing indicators, tool call indicators, and code blocks, with styling based on message roles.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class encapsulating styling options for chat bubbles, including alignment, background color, border color, and role label color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Main composable that renders a chat message bubble based on message role and content, filtering displayable parts.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: A container composable for chat bubbles, handling layout, border, background, and role label display.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Displays the content parts of a chat message, handling text and image parts.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Displays a typing indicator bubble (animated dots and text).

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Shows a bubble indicating pending tool calls, with a list of running tools.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a bubble for streaming assistant responses, with custom style.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Determines styling for chat bubbles based on role ('user', 'system', other).

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Maps role identifiers to display labels.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image decoded from base64 inside a styled container or shows an error if decoding fails.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Animates a pulsing dot indicator (used for typing indicator).

methods.name: PulseDot
methods.description: Represents a single pulsing dot with given opacity and color.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays a styled code block with optional language label.
